paragraphs.text: Renew the canopy gutter and its downspout as one exposed sheet-metal package. We are choosing prefinished aluminum to match the fascia.
The old downspout is galvanized steel. It is being replaced, not retained; the proposed color can be supplied on more than one metal.
Approve prefinished aluminum for both gutter and downspout. Matching color alone is insufficient; the old steel downspout is not a material reference.
Keep the existing outlet location. The adjacent canopy is outside this package.
Gutter: prefinished aluminum at the existing outlet location.
Downspout: prefinished galvanized steel in matching color. Adjacent canopy excluded.
